stem: Formative: A fault requires opening an electrical enclosure not assigned to the operator. What is the correct action?
choices: Open it carefully with insulated gloves.
Ask a coworker to watch while opening it.
Preserve equipment status and refer the work to the qualified/authorized role.
rationale: Preserve equipment status and refer the work to the qualified/authorized role. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
